mensagens.input: Kewana and Adam are earning money by painting both sides of a fence. When it was lunch time, they decided to compare who has painted more since they started. Use the number line to find out which student has painted more of the fence.
Kewana has painted 2/3 of one side of the fence.
Adam has painted 4/7 of the other side of the fence.
